english: You approach the giant cat-like head, realizing the stone by its maw is shimmering.
The surface pulses with ancient magic.
(Place your gloved hand on the surface.)
As your palm touches the cold stone, it warms beneath your touch.
A voice echoes through your mind, speaking in an ancient tongue.
Cat-speech. The language of the Whitemane tribe.
Crinblanca. Whitemane. The walking god of cats.
That's pretty much what it said.
Also, I'm getting really tired of these spooky cat ruins by now. Just thought I'd let you know.
But I don't think that's the answer it's looking for.
Or leave this barbaric culture in the Divine Era, where it belongs.
I serve the people of Norvik.
A grinding sound as ancient mechanisms activate.
The maw opens slowly, revealing a cavity within.
Your fingers close around cold metal.
You pull out an ancient amulet, made out of pure gold.
Holy shit! Yeah, you could fetch a pile of crowns for this bad boy.
Time to serve this dead cat god, I guess.
Yeah. Wow. That is a REALLY nice piece of loot.
Oh yeah. That could absolutely fetch you a pile of crowns.
I feel like that could end up badly. Anyway.
Good job. Now can we leave this creepy place?
The stone maw grinds shut once more.
The stone remains cold and lifeless.
If Whitemane doesn't work, then I got no clue. Unless you wanna try, uh... Blanco-Mano...? I think that's how it's translated.
Maybe you need to understand what it's asking first.
Well shit. Can't help you there.
Guess the cat doesn't care about your god.
Hmm. Not impressed by that either.
